text:
Priya: FYI vendor AcmeCloud opened a dispute saying customer was billed twice for Feb invoice. They attached a PDF showing two identical descriptors. They want a refund by EOD.

Payments Bot: Automated: settlement check for invoice inv_5542: captures=1, refunds=0, settled_amount=USD 12,480, settlement_id=stl_9912. No duplicate settlement found.

Omar: Priya can you drop the vendor PDF link? Need to compare descriptors.

Priya: Link: https://internal.redwood/secure/files/acme-claim-5542.pdf (access requires SAML). Descriptor shown: "REDWOOD CLOUD*ACMECLOUD" twice on their screenshot.

Lucas: Sometimes bank shows both authorization and a separate clearing as charges. Can we get gateway raw events for that card (card last4 1129)?

Payments Bot: Exported gateway events: event_01 auth 2026-02-24T10:04Z, event_02 capture 2026-02-24T10:05Z, event_03 clearing 2026-02-25T02:10Z. No second capture. Link: https://internal.redwood/gateway/exports/evt-inv_5542.csv

Elena: Vendor says cardholder called issuing bank and sees two posted charges with same amount. Could be pending auth + posted charge. Ask them which two timestamps.

Priya: Vendor support replied: customer supplied screenshots with timestamps 02/24 10:05 and 02/25 02:12. They insisted both are posted.

Tariq: Banking networks sometimes display a pre-auth and final post as two lines. Banks usually reverse the pre-auth within 7 days. Ask vendor to confirm if one line is marked "pending" or "pre-authorization".

Legal - Rivera: Hold off refunds until we assemble evidence. If AcmeCloud threatens chargeback, we need merchant descriptor, settlement ID, authorization ID, AVS/CVV, signed invoice and sales contract. Also need customer communication logs showing consent.

Priya: Uploaded docs: signed_invoice.pdf, sales_order_993.pdf, email_consent_thread.txt, support_chat_transcript.txt -> https://internal.redwood/secure/flows/packet-inv5542

Omar: I spot repeated retry webhook at 02/25 02:10 caused by gateway timeout. It logged a duplicate webhook but gateway idempotency key prevented second capture. I attached webhook trace.

Payments Bot: Webhook trace: webhook_778 -> status delivered, idempotency_key=inv_5542-key. Duplicate webhook ignored.

Lucas: Good. But issuing bank UI can still show both webhook event and settled charge as two lines. We should prepare a bank response packet: include settlement report, webhook trace, idempotency header, customer signed invoice, and communication proving single authorization.

Priya: Vendor requests immediate refund to keep customer happy. They say customer is escalating with their bank.

Legal - Rivera: If they escalate to chargeback, we have 10 days to respond with representment docs for card networks. Compile and submit. For now we can offer a courtesy credit only after we confirm customer actually paid twice (not just UI dup).

Elena: Treasury — can you confirm if any manual ACH/force-capture occurred? Could the vendor have processed a second charge on their side? @Tariq

Tariq: Confirmed: no manual captures on our merchant account. Vendor-side double-billing is possible. We need vendor payment logs proving they attempted a second capture. Ask AcmeCloud for their merchant logs and processor confirmation.

Vendor Support (AcmeCloud): We're pulling our logs now. We see two authorization attempts from gateway token tok_zz91 but only one settlement. We will provide processor reference IDs in 30m.

Priya: Thanks. Action items: 1) Legal to draft bank response packet. 2) Payments to finalize export with idempotency headers + settlement csv. 3) Treasury to verify no manual adjustments. 4) Ask vendor for their processor refs. 5) Do not issue refund until we confirm duplicate posted funds.

Omar: I'll assemble the representment packet skeleton: fields needed: merchant descriptor, settlement ID, auth ID, itemized invoice, proof of delivery/consent, webhook trace, gateway logs.

Lucas: Also include merchant descriptor explanation note: we changed descriptor on 02/01 to include vendor name; bank UI might show both old/new descriptors if they cache.

Priya: Timeline: vendor said customer will dispute with bank by 02/28 COB. We should aim to submit packet by 02/27 to preempt.

Legal - Rivera: Acknowledged. I'll draft template and run it by payments. If vendor produces processor refs showing they charged twice, we will refund and adjust reconciliation.

Payments Bot: Reminder: settlement holds workflow requires finance approval for any refunds > $5k. This transaction amount is $12,480. Escalate to finance@redwood.com.

Priya: Noted. I'll escalate once we have vendor logs. Updating ticket FIN-INV-5542.

Vendor Support (AcmeCloud): Sent processor refs: pr_44211 and pr_44212. One is a pre-auth void, one is settlement pr_44211. We'll email full batch logs to priya@redwood.com.

Tariq: Received refs. pr_44212 shows status VOID at processor; pr_44211 shows SETTLED. That matches our side. I recommend we send vendor a short customer-facing explainer to help them show the bank (pending vs posted) and offer a goodwill credit of $50 while we resolve.

Priya: I'll send the explainer and email vendor finance. Keep hold on refund. If bank pushes chargeback after we submit representment, we'll contest with packet.

Omar: Packet ready for review in /secure/flows/packet-inv5542/representment_draft.pdf. Please review and comment.

Legal - Rivera: Reviewing now. Will finalize language and include card network codes.

Priya: Thanks team. Will update once vendor confirms bank reclassification or issues a refund.
